photos.alt: Sahaj sitting on the stone walls of Amman’s Citadel, with the city behind him.
Amman’s pale buildings and hills beneath a cloudy morning sky.
The blue dome and two minarets of King Abdullah I Mosque in Amman.

The columns of the Temple of Hercules above Amman.

Meat and rice served with flatbread and a bowl of sauce in Amman.
A pistachio-covered sweet on a small plate in Amman.
Visitors beneath the tall rose-coloured façade of Petra’s Treasury.
The carved sandstone façade of the Monastery at Petra.

Pale dome tents scattered across a Wadi Rum desert camp.

Red upholstered chairs facing the desert through the windows of a camp lounge.
Palm trees and the waterfront in Aqaba, with mountains across the water.
